title: Cleo AI | Thirdway
description: Thirdway partners with owners, occupiers, and professional teams to create world-class spaces.

main.className: container mb-10 flex flex-col text-center text-pretty xl:mb-16

main: A platform, built around the day.

main.className: relative m-2 aspect-377/361 overflow-hidden rounded-xs lg:m-4 lg:aspect-1408/792

main: A workplace as warm as it is considered, Cleo's London flagship translates the  AI-powered brand into something closer to a mid-century penthouse than a fintech office.

Throughout, creativity is a given, not an afterthought. Inspired by Hugo Toro and Frank Lloyd Wright, rich timbers, metal accents, and bold joinery bring an elevated comfort to every corner. Brass details & layered materiality then add character to the space, in the same tactile, expressive manner Cleo approaches its entire identity.
An experience fitting with the future of AI-driven banking.

main.className: aspect-[16/9] relative mx-2 overflow-hidden rounded-xs lg:mx-4 lg:aspect-[1408/792]

main: Rather than designing areas and squeezing people into them, we worked with Cleo to understand how their teams actually move through a day. Then built around that.

The floor runs as a gradient. Social and collaborative at one end, quiet and focused at the other. It is genuinely useful, without losing that sensory richness. A space that looks the part and works just as hard.
